page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no marginal notes. Running head at top, with page number 142 at the left. A small ornament at the foot of the text, not transcribed.

main_text.p: ciet imperfectam: domum verò suam fine or-dine abire finet auctor ille gratiæ.

Huius autem ordinis quem Deus in domi-cilio suo constituit, duplex est ratio: Vna, sim-plex, propria, & necessaria; altera, composita fi-guris & ceremoniis, atque ambulatoria. Quam utramque rationem distinctè Deus posuit in prisca ecclesia Iudæorum. Partes verò pro ratio-ne obiecti duæ: Vna Ciuilis, ad rerum humana-rum administrationem spectans; altera Eccle-siastica, ad rerum sacrarum procurationem. Has duas partes secundum modum quem ante perstrinximus, Propheta attingit, dicens primùm quidem de rebus sacris & diuinis, Vt confidere thronos tui; deinde verò de humanis, Ibidem esse thronos domui Danidis. Quapropter vt singulæ huius versûs partes melius intelligantur, primùm administrationes illæ ex Prophetæ verbis distinguendæ sunt; post viden-dum quid fit quod de illis administrationibus prædicatur.

Ac primùm quidem id necesse est obseruari, administrationes metonymicè thronorum vel foliorum [?] appellatione designari. Notum est eos qui iuri dicundo præfunt, & alios qui auctoritate præualent, ex foliis [?] responsa dare consulen-tibus: & folia [?] esse iuris, auctoritatis, & potestatis signa. Cum itaque Propheta non vnius thro-ni aut folia, sed complurium meminerit, eo significatum voluit à Deo esse potestates, vt Aposto-lus

page.notes: Long s is read as f in several words and normalised to s (e.g. "præfunt", "responsa", "composita"). The word "foliorum" and the following "foliis", "folia" are doubtful: they may be errors for another word (sedium, sedis, sedibus), so they are marked [?]. "tui" after "thronos" is doubtful, marked [?] in the text: the printed form is unclear. "Danidis" is printed as such (for Davidis) and left as printed. The "Ivi" on the scan is read as "tui". The last word "Aposto-lus" is broken at the line end and continues on the next page. A small ornament at the foot is not transcribed. The text may be a sentence fragment at the page end.
